findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_free_report, purchase_report · Private data: get_products, list_checks, resolve_building, create_free_report, get_report_status, purchase_report · Public sink: search_address, resolve_building, create_free_report, purchase_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_free_report, purchase_report · Private data: get_products, list_checks, resolve_building, create_free_report, get_report_status, purchase_report · Public sink: search_address, resolve_building, create_free_report, purchase_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
